BiblicalUsage: A tenth part is the measure for the offerings, the flour that goes with the lamb. In Exodus 29:40 a tenth deal of flour mingled with oil is offered with the lamb, in Leviticus 23:13 the meat offering is two tenth deals of fine flour, and in Numbers 15:4 the offering is a tenth deal of flour mingled with oil.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the tenth part is the picture of proportion: God does not ask for the whole harvest in the offering. He asks for a measured part, given willingly.
